description: STATUS: OWNER-APPROVED for this submission on 30 October 2026. The project owner approved all ten entries (8 synthetic test passwords and 2 documented false positives) and confirmed that none of the eight test passwords is used for any real account or system. The entries were proposed by the development agent after it read each finding with its value masked. KNOWN LIMITATION: the scanner reports at most one finding per line and an entry matches only the first credential-like text on its line, so a second credential-like assignment added to one of these ten lines would not be examined; the scanner is not claimed to be perfect. An entry suppresses a finding only when the file, the finding kind and the SHA-256 of the exact matched text all match, so a changed value, a moved value or any new finding is reported again. The hashes are of text already in the repository; list candidates with `node scripts/dev/secret-scan.js --digests` and add an entry only after reading the finding.
